title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: A method with no body borrowed one
summary: A method declared in an interface has no body. The code measuring how far a declaration reaches went looking for one anyway and closed on the brace of the class written below.

highlights.title: Removal No Longer Eats The Class
highlights.description: Removing an unused interface method deleted around fifty live lines, the implementing class included. The extent now stops at the signature.

highlights.title: Fourteen False Reports Gone
highlights.description: Calls living inside the swallowed class counted as mentions of the method itself, so implemented and called members were reported as unreferenced. The report goes from 316 to 302 on a real project.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: Found by applying every removal the four dead code detectors offer on a real project and checking the file still balances: 400 removals in total, all clean now.
A member with no body is left out of the report entirely. Losing a finding costs nothing, keeping one that deletes live code costs everything.
